finalText:
**Build is green now.** Two real bugs, not noise.

`resolveRetries` in [options.js:7](src/core/options.js:7) read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now passes `retryCount`. That threw and aborted the build.

`isBackoffEnabled` in [retryPolicy.js:8](src/net/retryPolicy.js:8) treated an unset flag as invalid instead of `false`, since the new config loader leaves it `undefined` rather than `false`.

Fixed both. Rest of the warnings are just deprecation noise from the bump.

Next: nothing.
